label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
output:
Here you go — copy and paste this as it is, or swap the sign-off for your own name:

---

Hiya all,

Right, I've got a plan and I need your help with it.

Gran turns 80 on Sunday 13th, and we've got her dinner booked for 8.30 on the Saturday night before — the Italian place on Byres Road, table for 9 (Davie and Kirsty's man included, so nobody nipping off for a ciggie mid-meal).

Here's the secret bit. Morag at Hair by Morag on Dumbarton Road has let me have the salon to myself from 1pm on Saturday the 12th. Morag closes at 12 on a Saturday, so it's ours all afternoon. I'm doing everyone's hair for free — and I mean free, no arguing, no chipping in for the privilege.

Gran doesn't know, so somebody needs to get her there for 1pm without telling her why. That's you, Mum — you're the only one she'd actually believe.

Seven heads getting done: me, you three, Gran, Ava and Ruby.

What I need off you lot by Friday 27th November: colours. I order from the wholesaler and I can't do that the Friday before, so if you want a colour change I need to know the shade, how far you want to go lighter or darker, all of it. Cut and blowdry everyone gets anyway, no charge. If you want colour and you don't tell me in time, you'll sit there watching Ava get glitter sprayed and think about what you missed out on.

Gran — she said at Easter she'd love to go properly silver. Just so you know, that's happening, and I'm not charging her salon prices for it either.

Auntie Linda, before you ask: no, we're not doing it in your kitchen. Last time you had dye on the cooker and on the dog.

Ava and Ruby can have wee braids and glitter spray. They'll love it.

Kirsty, drop me a text on what the wee ones actually want so I order the right bits.

Last thing — someone bring a bottle of fizz. Morag says that's fine as long as we tidy up after ourselves.

Cannot wait for this one.

[Your name]

---

One thought: if the invite cards are going out separately, you might want to put the "reply by 27 Nov" bit on the card too, so nobody misses the deadline.
